newsitem.title: USA: Michigan sells $900 million of GO notes.
newsitem.headline: Michigan sells $900 million of GO notes.

text.p: The State of Michigan sold $900 million of full faith and credit general obligation notes in a competitive auction, with a 4.50 percent coupon and an overall net interest cost of 3.505430 percent (NIC).

Prudential Securities won $150 million of the notes. The firm won $50 million with a 3.483158 percent net interest cost (NIC), $50 million with a 3.502105 percent NIC, and $50 million 3.513158 percent NIC.
Bear Stearns & Co won $50 million of notes with a 3.483158 percent NIC.
First Chicago won $50 million of the notes with a 3.492632 percent NIC.
Bank of America won $50 million 3.502105 percent NIC.
BT Securities $50 million of the notes with a 3.507000 percent NIC and $50 million with a 3.516000 percent NIC.
Merrill Lynch & Co won $300 million of the notes with a 3.507632 percent NIC.
Lehman Brothers won $200 million of notes with a 3.513158 percent NIC.
